Claude ChatGPT Gemini Perplexity DeepSeek Mistral Qwen Llama When to use Feature cards about model choice, routing or "bring your own model" Landing pages that list supported AI providers in a calm, moving way When not to use A real model picker – the wheel can be spun, but it doesn't report a choice Long lists – the drum shows about seven rows at a time Installation Add Model Wheel with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19.
